Junie.description: While within 60' of you, any ally can use their own bonus action to grant themselves one of your Bardic Inspiration dice. Dice gained in this way have a +2 bonus when rolled.
Junie.upgrade: dice gained in this way have a +2 bonus/1

Junie.description: Whenever you grant a Bardic Inspiration die to a creature, you can also grant one to another ally within range at the same time.
Junie.upgrade: +10% for the extra die to not cost one of your dice/1

Junie.description: You gain 1 additional use of Bardic Inspiration.
